string.text: Boar Migration
Stalkers report a large herd of boars. One is especially tough, probably their leader. Don’t go without a shotgun and explosives—they’ll trample you and then eat you...
Underground Creatures
Strange business. Some on the radio claim they saw odd bandits in cloaks; others say little creatures crawled out from underground. Are they lying or is it true? Who knows.
Cat Fight
The radio mentions a pack of cats. They used to fear stalkers, but now hunger drives them to attack for food. Bring something rapid-firing; a shotgun may not be enough...
Toll for Passage
Stalkers on the radio say they saw a Controller there. Could be a story, but I heard two loners were taken to the outer perimeter, minds turned to mush.
Hungry Dogs
A pack of mangy mutts. No idea if they’re heading there to feed or just run around. Either way, a shotgun won’t weigh me down if I go. Neither will a grenade.
Terrifying Footsteps
This sounds absurd. They say there’s a whole herd of pseudogiants there, one especially huge—big enough for two. Maybe it’s their leader. My mind must be going; how is that even possible?..
Grim Hunt

Radio reports say two of our squads were mauled there. Strangely, the creatures seem to be gathering in packs, even those that usually stay hidden by day. The stalkers who went there were experienced, so I’d better be careful.
Hungry Lurkers

Those damned creatures have left their dens. A herd of hogs must have passed through, since the whole pack went out to feed. Just don’t arrive in the middle of their feast, or you might become a snack.
Mutant Stampede

The radio says a horde of mutants bolted from the Zone’s north. I don’t know what they’re running from, but such events are called a stampede. They charge blindly to get away... those creatures must sense something.
Apex Predator
Radio chatter says a dangerous creature was seen there. It’s hungry, too—it has already eaten one of our squads. Maybe I should leave it for another time...
Psi Horde
The radio reports an army of zombified stalkers heading there. No idea if their brains were “tweaked” or someone is leading them, but charging in is a bad idea. Maybe bring a sniper rifle...
Psionic Storm

A psionic storm is raging here. Psi energy fills the area and burns the minds of living beings. An unbearable hum in your head, voices from nowhere... Without protection, you could lose your mind. Psi waves stun mutant brains like a jammer. They sense the storm before us and gather in packs to wait it out. [Periodic psi bursts; damage depends on region] [Mutant movement reduced]
Radioactive Wind

Wind from the Zone’s north has brought radioactive dust and grime. Radiation is stronger than usual; bring anti-radiation medicine or a respirator. Better take both. Even hardened thugs wait out the dusty contamination in shelter. Stalkers by a campfire are probably waiting for it to pass too. [Background radiation] [Squad activity reduced]
Radioactive Hurricane

A terrible gale from the Zone’s north has brought a huge amount of radioactive dust and grime. Radiation is intense enough to make you wish for lead underwear. I’m not going without a suit. In this weather even the boldest lose their urge to roam. Anyone sensible waits out the storm under a roof. [High background radiation] [Squad activity greatly reduced]
Military Raid

They say military squads were spotted there. No idea what they’re after, but they’re searching thoroughly. You can bribe them through an informant so they “won’t notice” you, but it’ll cost a lot. [Warning! Bribery may not work with NPC elimination tasks; a fix is in progress]
Bandit Shakedown

Those damn bandits are shaking down a fellow stalker again. Why can’t they leave us alone? Scum. You can arrange a deal through an informant to avoid a firefight. It’s unpleasant, but at least nobody shoots. [Warning! Bribery may not work with NPC elimination tasks; a fix is in progress]
New Owners

A terrified stalker came across a well-armed squad setting up a temporary camp. He couldn’t make out their insignia or patches. Who they are and what they want is unknown. The radio advises keeping your eyes open. [A large squad has occupied the location]
Clear Sky Patrol
Radio chatter says a Clear Sky patrol was spotted in this area. I don’t care what they’re doing, as long as they don’t shoot at me.
PMC Raid

They say mercenaries were spotted there, probably on another contract. You can bribe them through an informant so they “won’t notice” you, but their prices are outrageous. [Warning! Bribery may not work with NPC elimination tasks; a fix is in progress]
Monolith’s Will
The radio says Monolithians are wandering around there. Better be careful; you can’t reason with them...
Scientific Expedition

Rumor has it a scientific expedition is heading to this sector. It could be handy to pocket a couple of detectors if they “happen” to die... though upsetting Sakharov feels wrong. [Opening the package lowers your reputation. Gift it through the trade window for a reputation bonus]
Fellow Stalkers
A few of our guys are heading there on their own business. It’s more fun together! Maybe they’ll watch my back.
Runner

Looks like Sidorovich’s runner is roaming there. He may have some loot on him. Still, stealing from the old miser is a bad idea—who knows if he’ll remember and send thugs after you. [Opening the package lowers your reputation. Gift it through the trade window for a reputation bonus]
Snork Nests
Rumors say fresh snork nests have appeared there. Who knows where they came from, but they drag careless stalkers underground... Damn creatures—don’t underestimate them.
